The Core Philosophy

ARTISTBACKINTHEART,NOTTHESPREADSHEET.

Dive Bar Records is the brainchild of Ben O'Shea and Ruairi McLean, born from the North-West alternative scene - now run alongside Freya Millar.


With a combined two decades of experience as artists working our way up, we know what it's like to be on the wrong side of an industry that's becoming increasingly manufactured.

- B. O'Shea, R. McLean & F. Millar
